hook: Claude Opus 5.5 designed a LEGO duck from real parts, then wrote a 141-page instruction booklet for it
caption:
Claude Opus 5.5 was asked to design a life-size LEGO "Microduck" using real LEGO parts.
The result: a full build with a matching instruction booklet, piece by piece.
A glimpse at how far AI-assisted design has come.
